methods.quantiles: Nearest rank inside each JVM; phase parity sliced before sorting. No removed samples or cross-JVM pooling; p99=max at n90/45.

methods.scope: Synthetic CPU submission/glFinish completion and render-thread Java heap; no game FPS, loading-time, GC-pause or universal tail guarantee.
